brief:
Human rights advocates have organized a new flotilla mission sailing toward Gaza to challenge Israel's blockade, according to Al Jazeera English. The effort aims to draw international attention to humanitarian conditions in the territory and apply pressure for diplomatic intervention to end restrictions on aid and goods.

Organizers are calling on governments to guarantee the flotilla's safe passage and to take steps dismantling what they describe as a deadly blockade. The mission represents the latest in a series of attempts by activists to breach or circumvent maritime restrictions on Gaza, which have been in place for years and have limited the flow of supplies to the coastal enclave.
dek: Human rights advocates call for diplomatic measures to guarantee flotilla safety and end Israel's deadly Gaza blockade.
title: Activists launch new flotilla to challenge Gaza blockade
